name: g1_explore_room
_note: Milestone B, gates pre-registered before any held-out run. Development used room seeds 0-9 (nominal) only; the held-out nominal, shifted and no-cabinet seeds below were never run. Shifted: larger rooms (6.5-8 x 5.5-7 m vs 4.5-6 x 4-5.5), 1-2 cabinet-sized distractors and 3-5 other furniture (vs 0-1 and 1-3). no_cabinet: the nominal held-out generator with a handle-less crate in the cabinet's place. 'nearest' is the classical nearest-frontier baseline; it differs from 'gain' only in frontier choice.
